## About me

I am an economist with more than 9 years of experience in financial inclusion, transparency of financial services, bank credit and retail payment systems. Currently, I work as Lead Specialist in Payment Systems and Market Infrastructures Research at the Bank of Mexico.

Throughout my career I have worked with large volumes of information to generate statistics, create indicators and evaluate the impact of public policies and regulations on credit and payment systems in Mexico.

I have a degree in Economics from the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM) and currently I am pursuing a master's degree in Data Science at the Autonomous Technological Institute of Mexico (ITAM).

In my free time I enjoy spending time with my family, exercising, playing video games and watching Toluca FC games.

## Areas of interest
- Bank credit (commercial, consumer and housing),
- Financial inclusion and transparency of financial services,
- Retail payment systems (cards and low-value transfers),
- Applied econometrics and time series analysis,
- Machine learning and probabilistic models,
- Bayesian inference,
- Causal inference,
- Python, R and SQL.
